text.en: Four friends, Circle, Square, Triangle and Rectangle, each said they were the best. They asked the first person they met, a star, to decide.

Four friends, Circle, Square, Triangle and Rectangle, begin to fight about who is the best.
Circle says it is round and has no sharp edges. Square says it has four equal sides. Triangle says it has three sides, and Rectangle says it has two long and two short sides.
Each one names the things children make or eat in its shape. They cannot decide who is best.
So they decide to ask the first person they meet, who is a star.
The story teaches that every friend is special in their own way, and no one needs to be better than everyone.
Good friends do not fight over who is best. They respect each other's differences.
New words: edges, sides, equal, round.
